title: Nothing fancy or even nice imho.
text: Nothing fancy or even nice imho.. Meh, more for students accommodation rather than anything fancy.  The blackout does work as long as your rods are close to the window.  I would say the material is value plus.  Nothing fancy at all.  Functional is best to describe these set of curtains.

product_metadata.title: Amazon Brand - Pinzon Thermal Insulated Rod Pocket and Back Tab Blackout Curtains Navy Blue 52x63 Inch
features: An Amazon Brand — Package contains 2 panels. There are 3 hanging styles to choose from: back loops, rod pocket or with your own clip-rings.
Blocks out 90-99% of outside light for bedtime, privacy, and prevention of sun glare on televisions; thermal insulation keeps cool or warm air better contained in the room and reduces outside noise
Made of 100% polyester fabric with a silky look and a smooth, lustrous hand feel
Easy installation with your choice of back loop hanging or rod pocket
Machine washable below 86F on gentle cycle; do not bleach or tumble dry; low iron; do not use fabric softener
